sections.description:
Atomic Addons is an all-in-one Elementor addons plugin that adds 170+ Elementor widgets, ready-made Elementor templates, a mega menu builder, a header footer builder, and a complete WooCommerce builder to the Elementor page builder.

Download Atomic Addons for Free | All Elementor Widgets | Documentation

Looking for the best Elementor addons for WordPress? Atomic Addons is a complete toolkit of addons for Elementor that helps you build faster, smarter, more professional WordPress websites. Freelancers, agencies, developers, marketers, and business owners get the flexibility to create beautiful sites with drag and drop, without writing a single line of code.

The plugin includes a growing collection of 170+ Elementor widgets, importable Elementor templates, 12 WooCommerce extensions, and advanced design tools. Build landing pages, business websites, online stores, portfolios, and blogs with one lightweight addon for Elementor.

The free version comes with useful Elementor widgets, Elementor extensions, a library of ready-made Elementor templates, Live Copy Paste, SVG Support, responsive design controls, and other essential features to improve your website-building experience.

Upgrade to Atomic Addons Pro to unlock advanced Elementor widgets, premium Elementor templates, the WooCommerce Builder, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions, Mega Menu, premium addons for Elementor, marketing widgets, and many more powerful tools for creating dynamic, high-converting websites.

Built with clean, optimized code, Atomic Addons keeps your website fast and lightweight. Every widget loads only the CSS and JavaScript it actually uses, so your Elementor pages stay quick. Regular updates add new Elementor widgets, Elementor templates, and improvements.

Why Choose Atomic Addons as Your Elementor Addons Plugin?

  • 170+ Elementor widgets covering content, creative, navigation, posts, forms, marketing, and WooCommerce
  • Free and Pro Elementor widgets are documented separately below, so availability is clear before installation or upgrade
  • WordPress.org package includes free Elementor widgets, free Elementor extensions, and core plugin features
  • Atomic Addons Pro unlocks additional Pro widgets for Elementor, Pro extensions, and premium features
  • 5 free Elementor extensions and 16 Pro extensions for sections, columns, and containers
  • Elementor template library with importable Elementor templates, plus SVG Support, Live Copy Paste, and Duplicator in the free plugin
  • Mega Menu builder, Dynamic Tags, Display Conditions, and Variation Swatches in Pro
  • WooCommerce builder and WooCommerce widgets for grids, carousels, pricing, filters, and reviews
  • Header and footer builder plus a full Theme Builder for single posts and products
  • Mobile-first, fully responsive controls on every Elementor widget
  • Smooth animations, hover effects, and scroll interactions
  • Lightweight assets and performance-oriented defaults that will not slow your site down
  • Works with any WordPress theme and runs cleanly alongside other addons for Elementor
  • Regular updates with new Elementor widgets and Elementor templates, plus friendly support

Elementor Addons Built for Every Type of Website

Building a business site, agency portfolio, WooCommerce store, SaaS landing page, blog, or one-page site? Atomic Addons gives you the Elementor widgets and Elementor templates to do it without custom code.

**Free Elementor Widgets** (WordPress.org package)

  • Animated Link – Eye-catching animated hover links with underline, slide, and reveal effects for modern Elementor layouts.
  • Brand Carousel – Showcase client logos and brand partners in a responsive, autoplay Elementor carousel with touch swipe.
  • Brand Grid – Display brand, sponsor, or client logos in a clean responsive grid with hover effects.
  • Call Out – Highlight offers and key messages with a call-out box, icon, and inline call-to-action button.
  • Fancy List – Create styled feature or checklist items with custom icons, dividers, and hover states.
  • Featured Box – Present services or features in an icon box with heading, description, and link.
  • Image Stack – Stack overlapping images into a creative layered composition with custom offsets.
  • Static Carousel – Turn any set of custom slides into a touch-friendly, responsive Elementor carousel.

Creative Elementor Widgets

  • Creative Button – Animated Elementor buttons with gradient, hover, and icon effects for high-converting CTAs.
  • Dual Button – Place two call-to-action buttons side by side with an optional separator badge.
  • Slider – Full-width Elementor slider with captions, buttons, autoplay, and transition effects.
  • Hover Box – Reveal hidden content, text, or links on hover with smooth CSS transitions.
  • Hover Video – Play a silent video preview on hover, ideal for portfolios and product showcases.

  • Backdrop Filter – Blur, brightness, and backdrop filter effects for sections and columns.
  • Grid Line – Decorative grid lines and layout guides on containers.
  • Ripple Effects – Ripple animations on click or hover for interactive elements.
  • Tooltip – Custom tooltips with position, style, and trigger options.
  • Wrapper Link – Make containers or sections fully clickable with a custom link.

**Pro Elementor Extensions** (premium license)

These Pro addons for Elementor require a premium license:

  • AdBlock Detector – Detect ad blockers and show a custom message or fallback content.
  • Animated Gradient Background – Animated gradient backgrounds for sections and columns.
  • Confetti Effects – Confetti animations for celebrations, CTAs, or page events.
  • Cursor Effects – Custom cursor shapes, trails, and interactive cursor effects.
  • Custom CSS / JS – Add custom CSS and JavaScript scoped to sections or widgets.
  • Equal Height – Match column or widget heights for even grid-style layouts.
  • Floating Effects – Floating motion with translate, rotate, and scale on scroll or idle.
  • Liquid Glass Effects – Glassmorphism-style blur, transparency, and frosted surfaces.
  • Notation – Hand-drawn style underlines, highlights, brackets, and annotations.

Beyond the WooCommerce Elementor widgets, Atomic Addons Pro ships 12 full WooCommerce extensions that add real store functionality. Each one has its own on/off toggle and settings panel under Atomic Addons > WooCommerce, so you only load what your shop actually uses.

  • Product Wishlist – Let customers save products to a wishlist, with a My Account tab and the [atomel_wishlist] shortcode.

  • Currency Switcher – Let customers shop in their local currency with live exchange rates, fees, and rounding.
  • Checkout Field Editor – Add, edit, reorder, and validate WooCommerce checkout fields on classic and block checkout.
  • One Page Checkout – Let customers choose products and complete checkout on a single page.
  • Role Based Pricing – Set different prices per user role, hide prices, and control add-to-cart visibility.
  • Subscriptions – Offer products on a subscription, collect recurring revenue, and manage renewals.
  • Min / Max Quantities – Set minimum and maximum order quantities per product and for the whole cart.
  • Sales Notifications – Show social-proof purchase popups with recent orders or curated products.
  • Hide Add to Cart and Price – Hide prices and the add-to-cart button for selected products, roles, or logged-out visitors.

  • Flash Sale Countdown – Urgency-driven countdown timers on sale products.
  • Product Recommendations – Smart upsell and cross-sell blocks powered by purchase data.
  • WooCommerce Pre-Orders – Accept orders for products before they are available.
  • Distance Rate Shipping – Calculate shipping rates based on distance from your store.
  • Accommodation Bookings – Date-based room and accommodation booking for hospitality.

**Elementor Theme Builder**

Build custom headers, footers, single post layouts, and WooCommerce single product templates with full Elementor design control. Theme Builder widgets appear under Atomic Addons Pro (Single) in the editor when available.

**Elementor Header & Footer Builder**

Design custom headers and footers visually, with no theme file editing. Combine the Nav Menu, Mega Menu, Sub Menu, Mini Cart, Search, and Off-Canvas Elementor widgets, set sticky behaviour, and assign layouts site-wide or per page.

Turn Elementor into a full store builder. Design single product pages, shop archives, cart, checkout, and my account pages with dedicated WooCommerce Elementor widgets, then extend the store with the 12 WooCommerce extensions listed above.

Skip the blank canvas. Browse the built-in library of Elementor templates, import a ready-made page or block with one click, and customise every element with the standard Elementor controls. The Elementor templates cover landing pages, business sites, portfolios, shops, and blogs, and every imported template stays fully editable.

  • Contact Form, Contact Form 7, WPForms, Ninja Forms & Everest Forms – style any form plugin inside Elementor

**Who Are These Elementor Addons For?**

  • Freelancers who deliver client sites faster with ready-made Elementor widgets and Elementor templates
  • Agencies that need one consistent set of addons for Elementor across many projects
  • WooCommerce store owners who want full design control over product, cart, and checkout pages
  • Bloggers and publishers using dynamic post widgets, timelines, and reading progress
  • Business owners building a professional site without hiring a developer

More widgets and features are coming soon…
sections.installation:
Installing these Elementor addons takes less than a minute, and every Elementor widget is available right after activation.

Automatic installation (recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Atomic Addons for Elementor.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Make sure the Elementor page builder is installed and active.
  5. Open any page with Elementor and find the Atomic Addons Elementor widgets in the editor panel.
  6. Open Atomic Addons > Templates to import ready-made Elementor templates.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the atomic-elements folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Start using it by going to the Elementor editor.

Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Elementor page builder (free version is enough)
  • WooCommerce (only if you want to use the WooCommerce widgets and extensions)
sections.faq:
What are Atomic Addons for Elementor?

Atomic Addons is a free Elementor addons plugin that extends the Elementor page builder with 170+ Elementor widgets, ready-made Elementor templates, extensions, a header footer builder, and a WooCommerce builder. You install it next to Elementor and the new widgets appear directly in the Elementor editor panel.

Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

No. Atomic Addons works with the free version of Elementor. You do not need Elementor Pro to use any of the widgets, templates, or extensions included in this plugin.

How many Elementor widgets are included?

The plugin ships with 170+ Elementor widgets in total. The free WordPress.org package includes the free widgets and 5 free extensions listed above, and Atomic Addons Pro unlocks the remaining Pro widgets, 16 Pro extensions, and premium features such as the Mega Menu builder, Dynamic Tags, and Display Conditions.

Will these Elementor addons slow down my website?

No. Atomic Addons loads assets conditionally, so a widget’s CSS and JavaScript are only enqueued on pages where that widget is actually used. You can also disable any widget or extension you do not need from the plugin settings to keep your site as lean as possible.

Does this plugin support all WordPress themes?

Yes. Atomic Addons is compatible with all WordPress themes, including popular free and premium Elementor themes such as Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, and Kadence.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin includes WooCommerce widgets for product grids, carousels, filters, prices, reviews, cart, checkout, and my account pages, plus 12 WooCommerce extensions: Variation Swatches, Quick View, Product Wishlist, Product Compare, Currency Switcher, Checkout Field Editor, One Page Checkout, Role Based Pricing, Subscriptions, Min / Max Quantities, Sales Notifications, and Hide Add to Cart and Price.

Can I use Atomic Addons together with other Elementor addons?

Yes. Atomic Addons is built to run alongside other Elementor addon plugins without conflicts. Each widget uses its own namespaced styles and scripts.

Can I build headers and footers with this plugin?

Yes. The Theme Builder lets you design custom headers, footers, single post layouts, and WooCommerce single product templates with full Elementor design control.

Are there ready-made Elementor templates?

Yes. The Template Library lets you browse and import pre-built Elementor templates and blocks straight into your page, then customize every element.

Are these addons for Elementor free?

Yes. The WordPress.org download is a free Elementor addons plugin. It includes the free Elementor widgets, 5 free Elementor extensions, the Elementor template library, Live Copy Paste, Duplicator, and SVG Support at no cost. Atomic Addons Pro is optional and unlocks the remaining Pro Elementor widgets and extensions.

How many Elementor templates are included?

The Elementor template library ships with ready-made Elementor templates for landing pages, business sites, portfolios, shops, and blogs, and new Elementor templates are added in regular updates. Import any template with one click and every element stays fully editable in Elementor.

Where do I find the Elementor widgets after activation?

Open any page in the Elementor editor and look in the widget panel. All Atomic Addons Elementor widgets are grouped into their own categories, such as Content, Creative, Menu, Posts, Forms, Marketing, and WooCommerce, so they are easy to find next to the default Elementor widgets.

Can I disable the Elementor widgets I do not use?

Yes. Every widget and extension has an on/off toggle in the plugin settings. Turning off the Elementor widgets you do not need keeps the editor panel tidy and your site even lighter.

Do you provide tutorials and documentation?

Yes. We provide detailed documentation and video guides covering the plugin, every Elementor widget, every Elementor template, and each extension.

How do I get support for an issue?

Just contact us through the support forum or our website, and our technical team will follow up within 24 hours.

How do I get updates?

When we release a new version you will get an update notification in the WordPress plugin manager, so you can update from there in one click.
